verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents an official CLI (`npm install -g @hubspot/cli && hs init`, with account authorization). It ties the CLI into agentic workflows through its CLI-based Developer MCP server, which lets agentic development tools scaffold and manage HubSpot projects. Evidence is limited to install and getting-started snippets, and the documented scope is the developer platform rather than CRM data operations. missing for 10: documented command reference or depth of CLI capabilities, evidence of CLI-driven CRM data access, independent or hands-on corroboration.
